audit_scope.description: Trust model for EIP-7542 (eth/70 P2P handshake), EIP-1283 (SSTORE gas metering), EIP-2930 (access list transactions), Prague gas mechanics, and Cancun bloom filter operations.
in_scope: P2P peer handshake and block range negotiation (EIP-7542)
Access list transaction validation and execution (EIP-2930)

misclassified_entities.reason: Transaction validation is an internal EL component (part of the transaction pool validation pipeline), not an external entity.
Transaction execution start is an internal EVM state transition trigger, not an external entity.
The transaction executor is the EVM itself, which is an internal EL component.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Node
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P peers connect over unauthenticated channels; any node can join the network and send malformed handshake messages.

trusted_external_entities.name: Requesting Peer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peers requesting block ranges are unauthenticated and may send invalid range requests.

trusted_external_entities.name: Untrusted Peer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Explicitly labeled untrusted in the specification; represents adversarial peers.

trusted_external_entities.name: Malicious Peers
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Explicitly adversarial entities that may attempt protocol-level attacks via crafted messages.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: JSON-RPC eth_sendRawTransaction or P2P transaction propagation
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Transaction submitters are unauthenticated; anyone can submit transactions with arbitrary access lists.

trusted_external_entities.name: Network Peer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Network peers propagating transactions are unauthenticated P2P participants.

trusted_external_entities.name: RPC Client
trusted_external_entities.rationale: RPC clients querying bloom filter results are unauthenticated external consumers.

boundary_edges.data_crossing_boundary: Handshake messages with block range capabilities
EIP-2930 typed transactions with access lists
Log filter queries against bloom indices

gaps: EIP-1283 and Prague gas mechanics are purely internal EVM operations with no external entity interactions.
Cancun bloom filter spec had misclassified internal executor as external.
